info.title: INSYS Core API
info.description: Multi-tenant insurance administration platform. The tenant comes from the bearer token's tenant_id claim. Every response carries X-Correlation-Id: the caller's when it sent a valid one, else a new one; errors repeat it as correlationId. x-function lists the functions an operation belongs to (ADR-026): the caller needs any one of them, one per portal for an operation the portals share. Operations about the signed-in user and signed provider callbacks have none.

post.summary: Anonymise a deceased or dormant party whose retention has ended
post.description: D-34, OQ-120: retention is checked, not assumed. Refused with 409 PARTY_ANONYMISATION_BLOCKED while anything still keeps the party's data; the problem's `blocks` lists each (see ProblemDetails). Every Life, General and Health policy, membership and claim linked to the party, and every payment, counts, the party's own and those of parties merged into it. A record is OPEN until it reaches a final status; it is then IN_RETENTION for the tenant's record retention policy for its kind (POLICY, CLAIM or PAYMENT, /party/static/record-retention-policies; working default 7 years) from the business date it reached that status, by its status history. With no period in force for its kind it blocks as NO_RETENTION_POLICY. The audit evidence about the party blocks for the longest audit retention class from its latest event, and a legal hold in force on any of these records or their documents blocks as LEGAL_HOLD. A party that is not deceased or dormant is refused with 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION. Erasure for a living party is a data-subject request (Wave 6), not this operation.

get.description: Within the caller's scope (F103): a notification is in scope when the product and organisation node of the record it is about are. from/to filter on requestedAt. sourceType is GENERAL_CLAIM, LIFE_CLAIM, HEALTH_CLAIM, HEALTH_PREAUTH, GENERAL_POLICY or BILLING_ACCOUNT; sourceReference is that record's own number.

get.summary: Every notification type the party can receive, with their channels, whether they can opt out, and their consent for marketing (§4)

put.summary: Set a party's channels for a type, in order, or opt out of a marketing type (§4)
put.description: A whole replacement: channels in order (null or empty only when opting out). A service notice keeps at least one channel (PREFERENCE_NOT_ALLOWED to opt out). Opting out of marketing also records the withdrawal of its consent purpose in Party. optedOut false never grants consent: only Party's consents/grant does, and that also clears an opt-out; a withdrawal in Party sets optedOut. Audited. Completes asynchronously (GAP-027): an opt-out reaches the party's consent ledger as a withdrawal (party consents); read the consents again to see it.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional: the ETag from the last GET. When given, a stale version gives 412; without it, the replacement applies.

post.summary: A messaging provider reports a message's delivery at its callback address (ADR-023, §5.1)
post.description: No bearer token: the tenant and provider come only from endpointKey, and providerRef is matched only among that tenant's attempts with that provider. An unknown, retired or revoked key, a bad signature or a timestamp outside the tolerance (5 minutes) is 401 CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID, the same answer for all. A callback ID already received at the endpoint (kept for twice the tolerance) is 409 CALLBACK_REPLAYED. 204 when applied, and also for an unknown provider reference, so the provider does not retry it forever. A delivered message stays delivered: a later bounce or failure for it changes nothing.

parameters.name: X-Callback-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds when the provider signed; within the tolerance (5 minutes by default).

parameters.name: X-Callback-Id
parameters.description: The provider's unique ID for this callback, at most 100 characters; a repeat inside the replay window is refused.

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.callbackId.body" under the endpoint's signing secret, hex.

get.summary: The tenant's delivery callback endpoints, without their keys or secrets (ADR-023)

post.summary: Issue a messaging provider's delivery callback endpoint; an active one is rotated (ADR-023)
post.description: The key and signing secret are shown once, in this response (Cache-Control: no-store). The key is part of the callback URL, so keep it out of logs. The rotated endpoint is still accepted until Communications:Callbacks:Overlap (7 days) has passed. Audited. The response is not kept: a repeat with the same Idempotency-Key is refused with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_RESPONSE_NOT_KEPT.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. The response shows a secret once and is not kept: a repeat with the same key is refused (409 IDEMPOTENCY_RESPONSE_NOT_KEPT).

post.summary: Revoke a delivery callback endpoint at once, for a leaked key or secret (ADR-023)
post.description: Revoking an endpoint already revoked is refused with 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

code.description: The stable error code (the error code catalogue), for example VALIDATION_FAILED, NOT_FOUND, RATE_LIMITED or NOT_READY. Present on every error except a malformed request (400, 405, 415) rejected before an endpoint runs.

errors.description: Validation failures (422): field name, as the request body spells it (camel case, with a path such as lines[0].amount for a nested field), to its messages.

reason.description: Why it blocks. OPEN: the record has not reached a final status. IN_RETENTION: it reached one, and the tenant's retention period from that business date runs until `until`. LEGAL_HOLD: a legal hold is in force on the record or one of its documents. NO_RETENTION_POLICY: the tenant has no retention period in force for the record's kind, so it is kept (fail closed).

recordType.description: The record. Its retention kind: LIFE_POLICY, GENERAL_POLICY and HEALTH_MEMBERSHIP are POLICY; LIFE_CLAIM, GENERAL_CLAIM and HEALTH_CLAIM are CLAIM; PAYMENT is PAYMENT. AUDIT_EVIDENCE is the audit events about the party. PARTY is the party itself (a legal hold on one of its own documents).

recordId.description: The record; for AUDIT_EVIDENCE and PARTY, the party.

retention.description: The retention period that applies: POLICY, CLAIM or PAYMENT (the tenant's record retention policies, /party/static/record-retention-policies; working default 7 years), or AUDIT (the longest audit retention class). Null for LEGAL_HOLD.

until.description: For IN_RETENTION: the first business date on which the record no longer blocks. Null for every other reason.

holdId.description: For LEGAL_HOLD: the hold (null for a document flagged as held without a hold record). Null for every other reason.

documentId.description: For LEGAL_HOLD on a document: the held document. Null for every other reason.

blocks.description: Only with PARTY_ANONYMISATION_BLOCKED (409, D-34): each thing that still keeps the party's data. Anonymise again once none is left.

correlationId.description: The same value as the X-Correlation-Id response header, on every error (GAP-007).

traceId.description: The server's trace identifier, for support.

detailLanguage.description: Present when the detail stayed in English because the catalogue has no detail in the title's language; its value is then "en".

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. `code` is stable and never localised; `title` and `detail` follow the request's language.

screen.description: The SCREEN function (its code) that opens the record the approval is about, for example PAYMENT_PAYOUT_BATCHES (BR-005); the console maps it to its route.

currency.description: The limit's ISO 4217 currency: the authority row's own, or the tenant's base currency when the row has none.

extendBy.description: Counted as the step's timeline is (business or calendar days). An ISO 8601 duration, for example P10D or PT48H.

Problem422.description: Unprocessable Entity. Codes any operation may return: VALIDATION_FAILED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

Problem403.description: Forbidden. Codes any operation may return: FORBIDDEN, TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING, FUNCTION_NOT_GRANTED, FUNCTION_DISABLED, FEATURE_NOT_ENTITLED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, CHANNEL_NOT_ENABLED, CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED, CHANNEL_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, IDENTITY_NOT_LINKED.

Problem409.description: Conflict. Codes any operation may return: TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS, IDEMPOTENCY_RESPONSE_NOT_KEPT, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The request's correlation ID: the caller's X-Correlation-Id when it sent a valid one, else a new one. Errors carry it in correlationId too.

Content-Language.description: The language of the error's title (docs/specs/addenda/localisation.md §4).

Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying (on a 403, sent only with IDENTITY_NOT_LINKED: the sign-in is still being set up).

bearer.description: OIDC access token carrying sub and tenant_id. Permissions come from IAM role assignments.
